log.action: Use the overturned wagon for cover and brace.
log.narration: Turn 1 | Day 1, 12:01 amStrength checkd20: 15 -- successYou drop your shoulder into the splintered timber of the ruined wagon, planting your boots in the muck to lock down a brutal, unyielding defensive wedge. "Tuck your tail all you like, meat," Theron snarls, his theatrical welcome curdling into raw violence as he heaves his hooked blade with vicious, bone-splitting momentum.The steel bites into the wood inches from your skull with an obscene, wet thud, throwing chips of iron-banded pine straight into your teeth. Behind him in the dark, two shadowy skirmishers cock their heavy crossbows with a rhythmic, sickening clack.🔊………

log.action: Shout at Theron to yield before me butcher him.
log.narration: Turn 2 | Day 1, 12:02 amCharisma (Intimidation) checkd20: 8 -- failed"Yield the field, Wyndfall, or I carve you into dog meat where you stand," you roar over the biting drizzle.Theron just laughs, a wet, rattling bray that smells foully of sour beer and dried offal. "Yield to a half-starved stray with delusions of grandeur? Fuck yourself, Korrag," he barks, yanking his billhook free of the timber with a spray of splinters. "Master Valerius pays triple for you breathing, but he didn't say anything about keeping all your fucking limbs intact."🔊………

log.action: Shout at Theron to yield before me butcher him.
log.narration: Turn 3 | Day 1, 12:03 amCharisma (Intimidation) checkd20: 11 -- failed"Last chance, Theron," you bellow, stepping hard into the muck with cold iron leveled at his chest. "Drop the hook, or you bleed into the dirt tonight."The slaver sneers, his face twisting into an ugly, theatrical grimace of pure contempt as he shifts his grip along the haft."You always were a loud bastard right before a beating," he snarls, spitting a glob of bloody phlegm right at your boots. "Valerius owns every drop of blood in your thick northern skull, boy, and I'm here to collect the parcel."🔊………

log.action: Vault over the wagon to tackle the crossbowmen.
log.narration: Turn 4 | Day 1, 12:04 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 17 -- successYou launch yourself off the ruined wagon like a sack of spite and sharpened iron, clearing the splintered axle in one violent heave. The two skirmishers barely have time to choke on a curse before your boots take the first one full in the breastplate, driving him into the sodden ash with an exquisite crack of snapping ribs. The second slaver fumbles his heavy winch in raw panic, dropping the weapon as you wrap a gauntleted hand around his throat and slam his skull against the muddy rim of an iron-rimmed wheel. "Useless bloody cows," Theron roars from behind you, pivoting his heavy billhook as he charges the breach to cut you down from behind.🔊………

log.action: Use a fallen slaver as a human shield.
log.narration: Turn 5 | Day 1, 12:05 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 16 -- successYou yank the dazed crossbowman up by his collar just as Theron's billhook comes whistling down like a guillotine. The heavy, curved iron cleaves straight into the thrashing slaver's shoulder with an obscene crunch of gristle and collarbone, spraying hot, arterial filth directly into Theron's grinning face. The brute bellows in raw fury as his weapon binds tight in his own man's meat, wrenching his wrists hard enough to jar him off balance for a precious, bloody second."Get off my fucking steel, you lump of shit!" Theron screams, violently kicking the dying wretch away as he fights to yank the hooked blade free.🔊………

log.action: Turn and strike Theron with Power Strike.
log.narration: Turn 6 | Day 1, 12:06 amStrength (Attack) rolld20: 18 -- successDamage (Longsword + Power Strike)d20: 14 -- successYou pivot on a mud-slick heel and drive your longsword forward with the whole brutal weight of your shoulders behind it. The cold steel punches clean through Theron's boiled cuirass and grinds against his ribs with a sickening, wet crunch that knocks the foul wind completely out of him. He gags, vomiting a torrent of dark blood down his chin as his billhook slips from numb fingers and clatters into the sodden ash. Dropping heavily to his knees in the filth, the hulking slaver clutches his ruined chest, his theatrical swagger evaporating into raw, quivering terror."Wait, wait, don't carve me, Korrag, don't fucking do it," he wheezes, his voice bubbling through a throat full of red froth as he fumbles a clinking purse of coin from his belt and shoves it into the mud. "Valerius... he's running the pits beneath the High Gate in Ashenveil. He's brewing something foul in the dark, marking the fighters with witch-brands. I swear to the dead, that's all I know!"🔊………

log.action: Vault back behind the wagon to break line.
log.narration: Turn 7 | Day 1, 12:07 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 14 -- successYou kick off the muddy dirt and vault back over the splintered timber of the ruined wagon, putting the heavy wood between yourself and the road. Cold ash and drizzle wash the copper stink of fresh gore down your cheek while Theron groans in the muck on the far side, weeping dark red through his ruined breastplate. The gloom swallows the desolate crossroads in heavy, suffocating silence, broken only by the whistling of the wind and the gurgling rattle of dying men. "Korrag... don't leave me out here for the scavengers, you merciless bastard," Theron whimpers from the mud, his voice thinning into a pitiful whine.🔊………

log.action: Vault back behind the wagon to break line.
log.narration: Turn 8 | Day 1, 12:12 amWisdom (Perception) checkd20: 12 -- successYou crouch low behind the splintered pine, listening past the pathetic whimpers of the dying slaver to the vast, gray emptiness beyond the fork. Nothing moves along the road except the soot that dances on the freezing gale. Southward, the jagged silhouettes of Ashenveil's outer fortifications loom against the bruised horizon like rotten teeth, reeking faintly of sulfur and wet chimney smoke. If any more of Valerius's dogs were trailing the wagon, they have either lost the scent or decided not to die in a puddle today. "You're a stone-hearted prick, Korrag," Theron wheezes through the timber slats, his voice fading into the wet rattle of a punctured lung.🔊………

log.action: Search the dead slavers and take Theron's purse.
log.narration: Turn 9 | Day 1, 12:32 amIntelligence (Investigation) checkd20: 15 -- successYou step over the barricade and kick Theron aside like a sack of wet flour, stooping to snatch the sodden leather purse he dropped into the mud. Prowling through the carnage, you strip the dead crossbowmen with cold, professional efficiency, prying twenty-five tarnished silver and gold coins from their pockets along with a sheaf of blackened bolts and a serviceable iron dagger. Theron curls into a pathetic, shuddering ball against the wagon wheel, too terrified and broken to do anything except watch you rob his slaughtered crew blind. "Take it all, you greedy bastard, just leave me the breath in my ribs," the slaver croaks, teeth chattering as the freezing rain plasters gray soot across his bleeding face.🔊………

log.action: Rummage through the overturned merchant wagon for supplies.
log.narration: Turn 10 | Day 1, 12:57 amIntelligence (Investigation) checkd20: 14 -- successYou wrench aside a splintered crate of salted herring and rummage through the belly of the overturned wagon, kicking through scattered grain and soaked bolts of coarse wool. Tucked beneath a false bottom in an iron-banded chest, you turn up a pair of pitch-soaked torches and a heavy glass vial filled with a viscous, oily fluid that swirls with a nauseating violet sheen. It reeks of copper and burnt hair, stamped on the lead stopper with the crude silhouette of a horned collar, the undeniable signature of Valerius's fighting dens. "Don't drink that shit unless you want your heart to burst out your teeth, Northlander," Theron groans from the muck, shivering violently as he watches you pocket the vial.🔊………

log.action: Set off down the South Road toward Ashenveil.
log.narration: Turn 11 | Day 1, 2:57 amYou turn your back on the whimpering wreck of Theron Wyndfall and trudge down the South Road, letting the freezing mud churn beneath your boots. Two miserable hours later, the monumental basalt arch of Ashenveil's High Gate looms out of the sleet like the yawning jaws of a starved beast. Black iron braziers belch oily smoke into the dusk, illuminating a pair of armored gate wardens leaning on halberds who eye your blood-spattered chainmail with the weary, mercenary boredom unique to city guards on a shit shift. "Halt there, big meat," one guard grunts, a cynical elf with soot smeared across his pointed ears, leveling the crook of his weapon toward your chest. "Entry tax is two silver unless you've got business with the guild or blood to sell."🔊………

log.action: Push past the guards into Ashenveil.
log.narration: Turn 12 | Day 1, 3:02 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 17 -- successYou drop your shoulder and barge directly through the gate, knocking Quelarin's halberd aside with an armored forearm and sending the slender elf skidding across the sleet-slick flagstones."Bloody barbarian madman!" Quelarin snarls, his boots scrambling for purchase as his companion fumbles for a horn at his belt.You plunge into the labyrinth of Ashenveil before they can draw steel, swallowed instantly by the reeking dark of a narrow alley that plunges south toward the underbelly of the city. Low-hanging eaves drip greasy coal water onto your brow, and the distant, subterranean thrum of chanting or roaring crowds vibrates through the granite stones beneath your feet.🔊………

log.action: Follow the subterranean roaring deeper into the Low Quarter.
log.narration: Turn 13 | Day 1, 3:27 amWisdom (Perception) checkd20: 15 -- successThe reek of stale piss and cheap tallow thickens as you wind deeper into the Low Quarter's gut, guided by the muffled, guttural howl of blood-drunk spectators vibrating through the sewer grates. At the dead end of a blind alley choked with rotten fish guts, a set of slime-slick basalt stairs plunges straight into the earth beneath a massive iron door reinforced with rusted bands. Flanking the entrance under the sickly yellow flare of a whale-oil lamp stands a hulking, scarred tiefling wearing spiked brass knuckles and a notched cleaver, his slit eyes narrowing as your chainmail rattles in the dark."Wrong alley, stray meat," Kadrun rumbles, spitting a thick wad of crimson chew onto the stone between your boots. "Only two kinds go down these steps: those with the watchword, and fresh corpses for the butcher's hook. Speak it or bleed."🔊………

log.action: Duck deeper into the dark alley to lose pursuit.
log.narration: Turn 14 | Day 1, 3:37 amDexterity (Stealth) checkd20: 11 -- failedYou slip sideways into the greasy shadow of a crumbling timber abutment, pressing your chainmail flat against the rotting pine. The rusted links scrape the wet stone with a sharp metallic clatter that rings through the dead alley like an executioner's bell. Kadrun snarls, his notched cleaver whipping up from his hip while the iron door behind him groans open, spilling blinding furnace light and the stench of scorched blood into the freezing rain. "Run your sneaky mouth in the dirt, rat!" Kadrun roars, lunging off the slick basalt step directly at your throat.🔊………

log.action: Brace and deflect Kadrun's cleaver with Shield Wall.
log.narration: Turn 15 | Day 1, 3:38 amConstitution checkd20: 16 -- successYou drop into a low, iron stance, locking your shoulders and angling your forearms as Kadrun barrels down the slick stone. The heavy cleaver slams against your guard with the bone-jarring rattle of an anvil drop, but the braced weight of your Northlander muscle absorbs the brutal shock and throws the tiefling off balance. He grunts in fury, his cloven boots skidding across the sleet as he raises the butcher blade for a second, feral hack.🔊………

log.action: Shove past Kadrun and plunge through the iron door.
log.narration: Turn 16 | Day 1, 3:40 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 18 -- successYou slam your shoulder into Kadrun's horned chest with the unholy fury of a battering ram, sending the hulking bouncer sprawling into the alley slush with a wet, undignified wheeze.Before he can claw his cleaver out of the muck, you kick the heavy iron door wide and dive straight into the sweltering belly of the vault. The door bangs shut behind you, drowning the freezing sleet in a wall of deafening, bloodthirsty howls and thick clouds of acrid, greenish furnace smoke. Below you, circling a sunken sand arena slick with fresh gore, a crowd of masked degenerates screams as a branded gladiator tears an armored hound in half with bare, black-veined hands. Across the stone catwalk, an ornate iron grate leads into a private viewing box where hooded figures murmur over glowing glass alembics.🔊………

log.action: Vault the railing into the sunken sand arena.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 1, 3:41 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 16 -- successYou plant a heavy boot on the catwalk balustrade and throw yourself over the drop, your chainmail chiming like a funeral bell as you slam down into the churned, gore-soaked sand.The arena crowd screeches with feral delight, mistaking your suicide drop for a surprise contender tossed into the meat grinder. Ten paces away, the victorious pit-fighter, Brindun Pallwick, drops the shredded remnants of the war hound and wheels around, his eyes burning with an unnatural, sickly violet luminescence while thick black ichor pulses through the swollen veins in his neck. "More meat for the pot!" Brindun roars, his jaw unhinging slightly as he scoops a spiked spiked war club from the bloodied dirt and stomps toward you. Above the arena floor, behind the brass-barred viewing box, a cloaked figure quietly tilts a glowing vial of foul green draught into a silver funnel.🔊………

log.action: Cross the catwalk toward the private viewing box.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 1, 3:43 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 15 -- successYou ignore the brute's bellow, spring off a discarded iron shield, and haul yourself back up the timber staging toward the high gallery before Brindun's club can turn your spine into kindling.The heavy spiked bludgeon smashes into the wooden struts below you with a deafening crack, spraying splintered oak across the sand as you vault the gallery railing. Inside the curtained alcove, two masked acolytes drop their silver funnels in terror, revealing a massive, bubbling alembic distilling the rancid green draught straight into rows of lead-stoppered vials marked with Valerius's personal wax seal.Beneath the distillers, a brass cage holds the drained, branded husk of a captive gladiator whose chest is carved with glowing runes that siphon his vital blood directly into the boiling venom. The lead alchemist, a hollow-eyed gnome in velvet robes, fumbles frantically for a curved dagger while screeching for the arena guards.🔊………

log.action: Smash the bubbling alembic with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 19 | Day 1, 3:45 amStrength checkd20: 16 -- successYou sweep your longsword in a vicious two-handed arc, shearing straight through the brass fittings and shattering the thick glass alembic into a storm of crystalline shards and boiling, emerald slime.The acrid alchemical slurry detonates with a deafening hiss as it splashes the furnace coals, spewing suffocating billows of necrotic, jade-colored smoke that send the velvet-robed gnome and his shrieking flunkies gagging out the back curtains. Through the choking fog, the heavy iron gate of the gladiator pen below rattles off its hinges, and a massive, ash-gray figure drags itself out into the arena light.Across the broad chest of the ruined giant burns the weeping, charred brand of the Chained King, its hateful sigil throbbing in time with your own racing pulse. The brute lifts his scarred head, the necrotic fury in his glazed eyes cracking for a fleeting heartbeat into horrified, human recognition."Korrag?" Brindun wheezes, his voice a ruined grate of raw agony as black bile drips between his cracked teeth. "Kill me... gods, before the brand takes the rest of me!"🔊………

log.action: Unlock the brass cage to free the branded gladiator.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 1, 3:50 amStrength checkd20: 14 -- successYou slam your boot against the cage's scorched brass hasp, sheering the warped pins with a shower of green sparks and wrenching the door wide.Brindun collapses into your arms like a felled ox, his scorched skin radiating a sickening, feverish heat while the blackened veins across his ribs writhe like frantic maggots. The necrotic brand carved over his breastbone pulses violently, smoking and devouring the healthy flesh around it with a soft, ravenous hiss."No escaping this collar, brother," Brindun rasps, spitting a clot of curdled black blood onto your shoulder as his fingers claw into your chainmail. "Valerius... he's feeding us to the King in the Reach. It burns, Korrag. Put the cold steel through my heart before the rot crawls into my skull!"Beyond the gallery's velvet curtains, the sudden clatter of drawn halberds and the harsh bark of City Watch whistles signal the arrival of the guard captain, rapidly sealing off the exits.🔊………

log.action: Ask Brindun how to sever the brand's power.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 1, 3:53 amInsight checkd20: 11 -- successBrindun lets out a wet, rattling choke that sounds less like a man and more like a dying forge."You can't sever it with steel, you stubborn bastard," he wheezes, his burning fingers digging through your mail until the links bite your collarbone. "The witch-fire drinks your soul from the other end. Valerius anchors the tether in his sanctum at the Bleeding Spire, deep in the Blighted Reach. Only his death or mine snaps the thread."His blackened chest heaves, skin peeling like charred parchment around the weeping rune as heavy boots thunder up the wooden stairs behind the velvet hangings."Captain's coming with a purse full of blood money to drag me back to the vat," Brindun gasps, the necromancy flaring behind his eyes with sudden, feral spasms. "End it, Korrag. Don't let them turn me into soup for their pet god."🔊………

log.action: Ask Brindun how to sever the brand's power.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 1, 3:55 amInsight checkd20: 13 -- successBrindun grips your wrist with convulsive, bruising force, his pupils dilating until the whites of his eyes vanish beneath an oily, necrotic film."Listen to me, you thick-skulled fool," he snarls through foaming black phlegm, shaking you with the hideous, borrowed strength of the grave. "There is no hedge-wizard trick, no holy water, no herb in the dirt that cleanses a brand of the Chained King. It is a conduit carved straight into the soul. Either you slit my throat here on the boards, or you carve Valerius's black heart out of his chest at the Bleeding Spire."The heavy gallery curtains behind you rip open with a violent shriek of brass rings, framing Captain Theron's heavily armored enforcers, crossbows raised and leveled straight at your skulls."Make your peace with it, Korrag," Brindun screams over the metallic cocking of bows, his muscles locking in agonizing rigour. "Steel now, or we both hang from the rafters in chains!"🔊………

log.action: Plunge my dagger into Brindun's heart to grant mercy.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 1, 3:57 amAttack rolld20: 18 -- successYou drive the iron dagger straight between his ribs, punching through muscle and bone with the brutal efficiency of a pit-slaughter.Brindun gasps, a sharp, clean sound of sudden relief as the writhe of black veins shudders and collapses beneath his skin. The charred brand of the Chained King flares with a brilliant, violent burst of violet flame, then implodes with a hollow pop, scattering cold gray ash across the floorboards as the sorcerous conduit snaps forever."Thank you, brother," he whispers, his gray eyes softening into quiet peace before slipping entirely into stillness.Across the shattered viewing gallery, the lead crossbowman shrieks a curse as the dead gladiator's alchemical value turns to worthless cinder, his finger tightening on the iron trigger.🔊………

log.action: Tackle Brindun over the balcony into the sand below.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 1, 3:59 amStrength (Athletics) checkd20: 16 -- successAs crossbow bolts punch splintering divots into the gallery balustrade, you scoop Brindun's lifeless frame across your shoulders and heave both of you over the cedar rail.You hit the churned, gore-drenched sand of the pit with a bone-jarring thud, rolling hard to bleed the impact while steel quarrels whistle uselessly through the empty air above. The howling mob in the stands scrambles for the vomitoria in blind panic as the emerald stench of the ruined alembic drifts downward, leaving the arena floor littered with discarded tankards, dropped cloaks, and the twitching carcasses of dead pit beasts.Near the southern egress grating, a dead guard's satchel lies ripped open in the sawdust, spilling a crumpled route map marked with Valerius's slaver waystations in the wilderness beyond the High Gate.🔊………

log.action: Search the dead guard for coin and keys.
log.narration: Turn 25 | Day 1, 4:04 amInvestigation checkd20: 14 -- successYou roll the dead watchman onto his face, slicing his leather belt-pouch free with a swift flick of your dagger.Inside, twelve stamped sovereigns clink against a heavy, notched iron gate key caked in greasy tallow. Tucked beneath his breastplate rests a water-stained surveyor's parchment, detailing how the emerald filth from the alembics is channeled straight down into the ancient Undercroft beneath the city, pooling into a toxic, living spring that sickens the aqueducts.Above, the gallery balconies shudder as armored enforcers begin their descent down the stairs, their boots ringing out in furious cadence.🔊………

log.action: Snatch the route map from the torn satchel.

It is a courier route stamped with the sprawling wax seal of the High Council of Ashenveil, granting Valerius's hounds unhindered transit for fresh stock beneath the noses of the city watch. Some pampered bastard in velvet is actively bankrolling this butcher shop from the safety of the council chambers, trading living flesh for political leverage. The heavy iron door at the end of the corridor groans as crossbolts slide home. The sound of drawn steel echoes off the wet brickwork.🔊………

log.action: Search the dead guard for coin and keys.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 1, 4:08 amPerception checkd20: 11 -- successThe dead watchman has already yielded every sovereign, copper bit, and rusted tooth of iron on his carcass. Your fingers come back slick with grease and cooling blood from the empty scabbard and the split seams of his boots. Nothing remains on the meat but bruised boiled leather, soaked padding, and the faint, sulfurous stink of the pit's tainted floor. Behind the reinforced grating across the arena sands, heavy timber bars slam down into iron cradles with a concussive boom that rattles your back teeth. A muffled voice shrieks through the iron slats, demanding oil and fire to purge the pit.🔊………

log.action: Vault the timber barricade to ambush incoming enforcers.
log.narration: Turn 28 | Day 1, 4:09 amAthletics checkd20: 17 -- successYou plant a heavy boot against the split pine and vault the jagged palisade in a spray of splintered oak and iron links. The first enforcer through the iron grate is a square-jawed cultist in studded boiled leather, lantern held high and shortsword drawn, completely unprepared for ninety kilos of Northlander fury dropping directly onto his skull. You crush him into the sawdust with a sickening wet thump while a mangy, red-eyed mastiff snarls in the darkness behind him, fangs snapping inches from your greaves. "Kill the brute, light the fucking sand!" the cultist wheezes from beneath your heel.🔊………

log.action: Take cover behind the gallery staging from oil pots.
log.narration: Turn 29 | Day 1, 4:10 amDexterity checkd20: 15 -- successYou haul your bulk backward and wedge yourself deep into the shadow of the heavy oak joists just as clay pots shatter across the sand in twin bursts of greasy black flame. The heat singes your cheek, illuminating the snarling pit hound as it leaps through the burning grease with scorched fur and foaming jaws. The cultist scrambles up from the muck, blade raised to pin you against the timber struts while sulfurous smoke chokes the crawlspace."Burn him out of the timbers, tear his throat!" the enforcer roars over the crackle of pitch.🔊………

log.action: Power Strike the Cult Enforcer with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 30 | Day 1, 4:11 amStrength attack rolld20: 18 -- successPower Strike damaged20: 14 -- successYou lunge out from the blazing timber crib, putting your entire back into a vicious two-handed upward cleave that shears through the cultist's boiled leather cuirass with a wet, splintering crunch. The blade bites deep through his breastbone, painting the burning oak joists in hot crimson and knocking the breath clean out of him in a spray of blood and broken teeth. He stumbles back into the flames with a strangled shriek, clinging to his ruined chest while the red-eyed hound snaps at your sword arm, lunging straight for your exposed wrist.🔊………

log.action: Cleave through the charging Pit Hound with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 31 | Day 1, 4:12 amStrength attack rolld20: 16 -- successDamage rolld20: 11 -- successYou pivot on your back heel and whip the bloodied longsword across in a merciless horizontal arc, catching the lunging beast mid-leap. The edge shears clean through the hound's thick neck vertebrae with a concussive crack, sending the headless, twitching carcass cartwheeling into the flaming pitch while its snarling skull bounces into the darkness. The surviving cultist, choking on his own pulverized lungs against the scorched timbers, drops his shortsword into the gore and feebly claws at the wall, completely broken."Mercy, by the gods, don't feed me to the reach," he bubbles through a mouthful of black blood.🔊………

log.action: Activate Action Surge to strike down both foes.
log.narration: Turn 32 | Day 1, 4:13 amStrength attack rolld20: 19 -- successDamage rolld20: 9 -- successYou tap the raw well of Northern savagery coiled behind your ribs, bursting forward in a seamless flurry of blinding iron before the sputtering wretch can finish his prayer.The longsword's backswing whips upward in a clean diagonal stroke, severing the cultist's pleading hand and carving straight through his clavicle down into his gullet. He collapses into the sawdust in an untidy tangle of severed tendons and bubbling lungs, twitching once before settling into the grease beside his decapitated beast. Acrid smoke billows thick around the blood-drenched sand, and the vault beyond lies dead, echoing, and entirely yours.🔊………

log.action: Activate Action Surge to strike down both foes.
log.narration: Turn 33 | Day 1, 4:15 amBoth of the bastards are already stone-dead at your boots, their steaming gore curdling in the sawdust while the grease fires pop and dwindle down to greasy soot. You stand in the stench of burnt hair, split entrails, and hot tallow, your breath sawing through your teeth in the sudden, cavernous silence of the pit. Beyond the shattered iron gate, the long subterranean corridor plunges north toward the city's drainage gutters and south into the pitch-black depths of the Undercroft.🔊………

log.action: Cleave through the charging Pit Hound with my longsword.
log.narration: Turn 34 | Day 1, 4:16 amThe headless hound is already an unmoving pile of scorched meat cooling in the bloody sawdust. You wipe a greasy smear of hound fat and ash from the flat of your longsword, the steel chiming softly in the suffocating quiet. The smoke rolls thick toward the high brick vaulting, revealing an arched stone stairway winding up toward the rain-drowned alleys of the Low Quarter, while a foul, green-tinged drain gurgles toward the deep Undercroft below.🔊………

log.action: Head south down the corridor into the dark Undercroft.
log.narration: Turn 35 | Day 1, 4:31 amYou wade south into the subterranean dark, leaving the smoldering pit behind as the floor drops away into ankle-deep, lukewarm sludge.The masonry changes from crude mortar to colossal, ancient stonework slick with glowing jade moss that pulses like a fevered artery against the weeping basalt. The sweet, nauseating reek of corrupted alchemical runoff grows thick enough to coat your tongue, and deep within the flooded canals ahead, something massive shifts wetly through the black water.🔊………

log.action: Ascend the stone stairway toward the Low Quarter.
log.narration: Turn 36 | Day 1, 4:46 amYou haul your boots out of the Undercroft's emerald sludge, trudging back up the slick stone risers until the rancid stench of witch-bile gives way to the honest, dreary misery of Ashenveil's rain.The stairwell dumps you out into a narrow, mud-choked alley of the Low Quarter beneath sagging timber tenements that weep coal smoke into the freezing dark. Rain hammers down like lead shot against your chainmail, washing the greasy hound fat from your steel while distant watch horns drone out over the soot-stained roofs.🔊………

log.action: Take shelter beneath a sagging tenement eave.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 1, 4:56 amPerception checkd20: 12 -- successYou shove yourself deep into the reeking shadows under the rot-chewed eaves, the freezing downpour drumming against the greasy timber overhead like a fist on a pine coffin.Across the lane, two figures clad in the oilskin mantles of the City Watch kick an unconscious beggar out of the gutter, speaking in hushed, urgent rasps about a breached pit gate and an order signed by a Council seal to lock down the docks. A third shadow lingers in an upper casement window right above them, its silhouette framed by the faint, eerie glow of an alchemical brazier.🔊………

log.action: Confront the two City Watch guards.
log.narration: Turn 38 | Day 1, 5:01 amYou step out from under the rotting eaves into the driving freezing rain, your boots squelching loud and heavy in the gutter slush. The two watchmen spin around with a frantic rattle of ringmail and wet leather, halberds snapping level with your throat. "Hold your ground, you bloody ape," the taller guard, Hadden Brackstone, spits through missing teeth, his eyes dropping immediately to the gore-smeared crossguard of your longsword. "He's soaked in pit muck," his partner, a sharp-featured woman named Mira Mirefoot, mutters under her breath as she slips her thumb over a heavy crossbow trigger.
